verdict.rationale: Bruno supports environment variables/overrides (bruno-docs-11) and mock responses (bruno-docs-4) which could be used to point tests at a sandbox rather than production, but there is no explicit documentation or example framing this as a sandbox-vs-production testing workflow, nor any AI-native agent tie-in. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/production environment separation guidance, AI-agent-specific sandbox testing workflow, independent verification that mock/env features prevent production impact.
